scenes.say: Bitcoin lost more than four thousand dollars in about two hours today. It slid from above eighty thousand to around seventy six thousand, down roughly five percent in a day.
The trigger, according to market reports, was a selloff in chip and A I stocks. The Nasdaq fell as much as three point nine percent, and crypto followed.
Leverage made it worse. Reportedly more than seven hundred million dollars in crypto positions were liquidated over the day, mostly traders betting on higher prices.
Ether took a bigger hit. It dropped about seven percent in twenty four hours to around two thousand two hundred sixty five dollars, below the two thousand three hundred level.
Meanwhile gold went the other way. It rose about one point seven percent to roughly four thousand one hundred twenty seven dollars an ounce, as money looked for safety.
The Fear and Greed index sits at thirty four, in fear. Is this a dip or the start of something bigger? Tell me below, and follow for the facts every day.
